topic.title: Projects Overview
topic.shortdesc: Projects give authors a managed workspace for editing content, running reviews, and publishing output from repository-based content.

body.p: In , a project connects your documentation work to a Git repository. Projects provide the main workspace for authors.
Inside a project, authors can browse files, edit content, create review tasks, manage publications, and build deliverables.

ul.li: To work with repository-based content in a browser interface.
To manage changes across multiple files.
To prepare and publish documentation output.

section.title: Main Project Areas
section.p: A project typically includes a personal workspace for editing, review task management, publication setup, deliverable configuration, and project administration features.
